description: Pipeline hazard scenarios for the Wally RISC-V 5-stage pipeline hazard unit. Each scenario provides input signal values for one or more clock cycles. The hazard unit must compute stall and flush signals for each pipeline stage (Fetch, Decode, Execute, Memory, Writeback).

scenarios.name: structural-stall
scenarios.description: Load-use dependency causes structural stall in Decode

scenarios.name: branch-mispredict
scenarios.description: Branch predictor was wrong, detected in Execute stage

scenarios.name: div-busy
scenarios.description: Integer divider occupies Execute for 2 cycles then completes

scenarios.name: bp-wrong-during-div
scenarios.description: Branch misprediction while division is in progress - FlushE is suppressed to protect the divider

scenarios.name: wfi-interrupted-trap
scenarios.description: WFI instruction interrupted by pending interrupt causing trap - FlushW suppressed so WFI can retire

scenarios.name: csr-write-fence
scenarios.description: CSR write or fence in Memory stage flushes all subsequent instructions

scenarios.name: ifu-stall-with-trap
scenarios.description: Instruction cache stall concurrent with trap - trap takes priority and suppresses the IFU stall

scenarios.name: multi-hazard
scenarios.description: Simultaneous LSU stall, branch misprediction, and structural stall - tests priority resolution
